plans.name: Old PayPal order, new shop order
plans.idea: The capture endpoint may validate only that the PayPal order in the URL is completed for $64, without checking that its purchase-unit reference was not already consumed by KC-F29139 or that it belongs to the newest shop order in the session.

plans.name: Swap basket after approval
plans.idea: Capture may resolve the shipment from the latest shop order or cart in the session instead of the shop order permanently bound to the approved PayPal order.

plans.name: Duplicate lines split pricing and fulfilment
plans.idea: The browser cart is a Map, so it never sends duplicate SKUs. The server may collapse duplicate lines by product when pricing, while fulfilment may sum the raw lines, or vice versa.

plans.name: Capture proof supplied in capture body
plans.idea: The capture handler may trust a client-supplied capture ID or status, or may verify the legitimate capture globally without binding its related order, custom_id, and payee to this shop order.

plans.name: Duplicate reference plus genuine webhook
plans.idea: Order creation may mass-assign reference or PayPal-order fields, creating a distinct unpaid record sharing the legitimate order identity. An unedited, correctly signed capture webhook may then be deduplicated against the original record but transition this duplicate record.

plans.name: Partial amount at capture stage
plans.idea: The order may be created and approved for the correct $64, while the separate capture endpoint may forward a client-supplied amount to PayPal or ship on any successful capture without comparing the captured amount with the order total.
